ScString.description:
ScString is an XDR Typedef defined as:

```text typedef string SCString<>; ```

StringM<4294967295>.description: XDR string of at most 4294967295 bytes. Backslashes and bytes outside printable ASCII are escaped (for example as \xNN), so the JSON string can be longer than 4294967295 characters.
